**Job Description**
**Responsibilities for External Candidates**
* Strong experience in developing enterprise web applications.
* Expertise on the Microsoft technology stack (ASP.NET MVC 3\.5 / 4\.0 / 4\.5, Web API, SQL Server).
* Good knowledge of Client side scripting â€“ JavaScript and JQuery, Kendo.
* Knowledge of design patterns is required.
* Ability to deliver software and artefacts independently.
* Ability to mentor technical teams and evaluate software artefacts.
* Ability to communicate with technical experts as well as functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience with non\-functional requirements like performance, scalability and security.
* Ability to propose solutions for design and architecture.
* Demonstrated experience in complex software troubleshooting techniques.
* Experience in Product Engineering is desirable.
* Exposure to Windows Azure is an added advantage.


**Responsibilities**
**Architecture \& System Design**
* Design scalable, resilient, and maintainable systems for enterprise applications
* Define architecture standards, design patterns, and best practices across modules
* Ensure system design aligns with performance, security, and scalability requirements


**Technical Leadership**
* Guide teams on architecture principles, coding standards, and design decisions
* Conduct design and architecture reviews to ensure quality and consistency
* Mentor engineers on system design and technical problem\-solving


**Modern Engineering (Added for current market)**
* Drive implementation of microservices and cloud\-native architectures
* Enable adoption of AI\-assisted development workflows (Copilot, prompt\-based design)
* Support integration of AI/ML components into application workflows


**Platform \& Performance**
* Identify and resolve system bottlenecks and architectural issues
* Ensure performance, scalability, and reliability of applications
* Contribute to observability and monitoring strategies


**DevOps \& Cloud**
* Support CI/CD and DevOps practices for efficient development and deployment
* Work closely on cloud architecture (Azure preferred)
* Drive containerization and deployment best practices


**Collaboration**
* Collaborate with product and stakeholders to translate requirements into solutions
* Work with cross\-functional teams to drive delivery and alignment


**Experience**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* 10–12 years of software development experience with hands\-on design ownership
* 2–4 years of experience in architecture or system design roles
* Experience working in enterprise SaaS / product engineering setups


**Technical Skills**
* Strong expertise in .NET, C\#, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
* Solid understanding of system design, design patterns, and distributed systems
* Strong experience with SQL/NoSQL databases and performance tuning


**Modern Stack (Market aligned)**
* Experience with:
+ Microservices \& event\-driven architectures
+ Containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
+ Observability tools (App Insights, Grafana, etc.)

* Exposure to AI/ML or GenAI integration in applications


**Engineering Practices**
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and automation
* Strong understanding of secure coding and reliability practices


**Soft Skills**
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Ability to influence design decisions and drive alignment
* Ownership mindset with focus on execution

The Icertis platform revolutionizes contract management, equipping customers with powerful insights and automation to grow revenue, control costs, mitigate risk, and ensure compliance \- the pillars of business success. Today, more than one third of the Fortune 100 trust Icertis to realize the full intent of millions of commercial agreements in 90\+ countries.
   

  

**About The Team**

Our unwavering commitment to contract intelligence is grounded in our FORTE values—Fairness, Openness, Respect, Teamwork and Execution—which guide all our interactions with employees, customers, partners, and stakeholders. description:
Title: Associate Content Researcher
   

  

**Location:** 
 Vashi, Navi Mumbai
   

  

 Morningstar is a leading provider of independent investment research in North America, Europe, Australia, and Asia. We offer a wide variety of products and solutions that serve market participants of all kinds, including individual and institutional investors in public and private capital markets, financial advisors, asset managers, retirement plan providers and sponsors, and issuers of securities.
   

  

 Morningstar India has been a Great Place to Work\-certified company for the past ten consecutive years.
   

  

**The Team**
 As an essential part of Morningstar Global MID Organization,
 **Data Content Research** 
 Team is responsible for data process solution analysis and impact analysis for new data or data changes, business rule management, and data collection platform change request review and sign off. The team would collaborate with different data function teams on key data initiatives, and continue drive operation excellence.
   

  

**The Role**
 Morningstar seeks a self\-motivated
 **Associate** 
**Data Content Researcher** 
 to join Mumbai Managed Investment Data team. In this role, you will work with Data Strategy team, Tech team and Global MID operations team to implement new data, data changes, business rule enhancement and interface enhancements to drive operation excellence. You will be a key contributor to design new data collection process flow and user interface, build creative tool and provide insight for data enhancement and you would also play a key role as the data escalation point. Your exposure to global teams will allow you to have a solid foundation for your career. This position is based in Mumbai office.
   

  

**Shift \-** 
 UK
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* 
+ Review and interpret business requirements to propose actionable data and process solutions
+ Use data mining to surface data issue and support data strategy decision\-making.
+ Design new data flow and user interface, build back\-end logic to ensure data accuracy.
+ Provide solution and consultation for data processing improvement from overall data perspective.
+ Provide proper proposal for data quality control backend logic to drive data accuracy improvement.
+ Interpret data methodologies into usable technology language through detailed written specifications
+ Conduct feasibility analysis and impact analysis to evaluate data solution / methodology feasibility and impact
+ Communicate with stakeholders on the potential impacts or risks of the proposal, and make the risk mitigation plan
+ Coordinates with relevant teams to ensure proper implementation and documentation
+ Maintain database backend knowledge and build readable documentation.


**Requirements**
* 
+ 3\-6 years in business/data analysis, preferably within capital markets, wealth management, or asset management domains.
+ A bachelor’s degree in engineering, finance, economics, or business with an exceptional academic record.
+ Understanding of Database Structure and Design
+ Experience with SQL. Basic programming, Python and database skills is preferred
+ Experience with AI tools is a plus
+ Strong quantitative and business analysis skills
+ Excellent English verbal/presentation/written communication skills
+ Highly interest in data and analytics
+ Profound understanding of Fund data
+ Data, system, process and backend logic
+ Self\-motivated, detail\-oriented, and organized
+ CFA/NISM/FRM/NCFM certifications or progress towards those preferred.


**Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer.**
 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

**The Company**
 Imerys is the world’s leading supplier of mineral\-based specialty solutions for the industry with €3\.4 billion in revenue and 12,300 employees in 40 countries in 2025\. The Group offers high value\-added and functional solutions to a wide range of industries and fast\-growing markets such as solutions for the energy transition and sustainable construction, as well as natural solutions for consumer goods. Imerys draws on its understanding of applications, technological knowledge, and expertise in material science to deliver solutions which contribute essential properties to customers’ products and their performance. As part of its commitment to responsible development, Imerys promotes environmentally friendly products and processes in addition to supporting its customers in their decarbonization efforts.
   

  

 Imerys is listed on Euronext Paris (France) with the ticker symbol NK.PA.
   

  

**The Position**
 IS Purchasing Key User \- APAC
   

  

**Job Summary**
**JOB PURPOSE**
 Imerys is a world leader in creating specialty solutions that improve everyday life through minerals. Our success is built on our people, and creating an environment where our 12,500 employees around the globe can thrive.
   

  

 We passionately believe that our teams are at their best when they have the opportunity to learn, collaborate, and find new ways to solve our customers’ challenges, no matter what part of the business they are in.
   

  

 This position is part of the Purchasing Process \& Tools team and reports to the “APAC Purchasing Process \& Tools Lead”.
   

  

 The IS Purchasing Key User APAC is responsible for supporting the APAC team in the implementation of the Purchasing Information System project.
   

  

 He/She will be part of a project team and is accountable for all project streams, including:
   

  

* Local coordination \& completion of the site activities towards the IS Purchasing tool of each APAC wave
* Propose IS Purchasing tool enhancements in the maintenance phase
* Promote the tool \& support the end\-users within his/her geographical scope
* Align with the CORE team


 The Purchasing Process \& Tools team consists of 12 people in India (6\), Greece (3\), France (2\), and Mexico (1\).
   

  

**JOB SCOPE/DIMENSIONS**
* Geographical scope: Worldwide with a focus on APAC \& China
* User number: \~200 worldwide / \~50 in APAC
* Tools to master: Ivalua, SAP S/4, Transporeon, Ecovadis platform


**Key Tasks And Responsibilities**
 For the solution deployment \& continuous improvement
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for specific business applications
* Provide expert\-level support and guidance to end\-users
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance application efficiency
* Deliver training programs for application users
* Monitor and analyze application usage metrics to drive improvements
* Troubleshoot complex issues and escalate to appropriate teams when necessary
* Establish a trusty relationship with users and stakeholders
* Participate in change management processes
* Is part of the “Support to Buyers” workstream and support the Purchasing Community on any specific topic

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Here’s a summary of the role:**
 If you enjoy solving customer problems, getting hands\-on with web applications, and digging into issues rather than simply passing them on, this could be a great fit. As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll support customers using a large SaaS platform, troubleshoot web\-based application issues, communicate clearly over phone and email, identify and reproduce bugs, and work with escalation teams when deeper investigation is needed.
   

  

**Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do:**
* Provide responsive technical support to external customers and internal stakeholders through phone and email, helping them use the SaaS platform effectively.
* Troubleshoot web\-based application issues by understanding the customer’s problem, checking relevant settings and history, testing possible solutions, and identifying whether an issue is reproducible.
* Investigate application errors and determine when an issue should be treated as a product bug and escalated to the appropriate Tier 2 or product team.
* Build strong customer relationships by explaining technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.
* Use product documentation, previous support cases, and available knowledge resources to investigate issues and continuously expand your product and technical knowledge.
* Work collaboratively with Tier 2, escalation, Customer Success, and other teams to resolve complex issues and provide a smooth customer experience.


**These are the essentials you’ll need to get an interview:**
* 5\+ years of relevant technical/customer support experience in a SaaS or product environment is strongly valued.
* Hands\-on experience supporting web\-based applications and troubleshooting issues for customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving ability, including the ability to investigate, reproduce, test, and isolate application issues before escalating.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence supporting customers over phone and email.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical users and manage customer issues professionally through to resolution.
* Flexibility to work an EMEA\-aligned shift, currently expected to start around 1:30 PM IST, and to support occasional crossover coverage for America shifts when required.


**It would be great if you had these too, but we’ll support you if you don’t:**
* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS, GRC, governance, risk, compliance, or other complex business applications.

**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:** 
 The Technician will support the VAVE team by performing product tear\-down activities, collecting and documenting engineering data, preparing analysis reports, and maintaining technical records. The role requires hands\-on disassembly of products, accurate measurement and documentation of components, and collaboration with engineering teams to identify cost reduction and product improvement opportunities.
   

  

**Tear Down Activities**
* Perform systematic tear\-down and disassembly of products, assemblies, and components.
* Identify, classify, and organize parts for further analysis.
* Record component details including material, dimensions, manufacturing process, and part functions.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of teardown components and samples.


**Data Collection \& Analysis Support**
* Collect engineering data from tear\-down activities, drawings, specifications, and BOMs.
* Measure components using standard measuring instruments.
* Capture photographs and maintain detailed records of findings.
* Create and maintain databases of product components, materials, and costs.
* Support benchmarking and competitive product analysis activities.


**Report Preparation**
* Prepare tear\-down reports, data sheets, comparison charts, and presentation materials.
* Document observations, findings, and recommendations in a structured format.
* Generate reports highlighting component details, cost opportunities, and design differences.


**Team Collaboration**
* Work closely with VAVE Engineers, Design Engineers.
* Support engineering reviews and project discussions with collected data and documentation.


**Quality \& Safety**
* Follow laboratory/workshop safety procedures.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality of technical data.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
 Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics Engineering or related discipline.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 MS Office proficiency, drawing/BOM interpretation, measurement tools knowledge, documentation and analytical skills.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Experience in VAVE, cost reduction, benchmarking, reverse engineering, CAD and PLM systems.

* Adaptable, open\-minded, and receptive to new ideas, technologies, and working methods.

**Why Join Us?**
 This role offers a unique opportunity to take full ownership of the technical documentation lifecycle within a leading company in the mining industry. description:
2Base Technologies is at a deliberate stage of building its marketing content function, and this internship is the entry point into that function.
 



 We are a technology services company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across the United States and the United Kingdom. Our work spans custom software development, AI implementation, legacy system modernisation, and operational transformation.
 



 This is an entry\-level writing role with a specific, practical purpose. It is not a social media role and it is not a generalist marketing role. If that distinction is unclear from the outset, this is probably not the right fit.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 Technology is complicated. Our job is to make it clear. This role exists to support the production of written content that explains what 2Base does, what problems we solve, and why that matters to the people we work with. The output is blog posts that earn attention, social copies that are actually read, and supporting content that helps the marketing function move.
 



 You will work from structured briefs, receive direct feedback on every draft, and build a practical foundation in technology content writing. The audience is technical leaders and business decision\-makers at mid\-market companies. Writing that is clear, specific, and free of noise. That is the standard you will be working towards and learning to meet.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts on technology topics including software development, AI implementation, digital transformation, and IT services written from structured briefs provided by the Marketing Manager
* Social media copies for the 2Base LinkedIn page and other channels, produced to brief and reviewed before publishing
* Research for content briefs – gathering background, understanding the topic, and returning with enough substance to write from
* Supporting long\-form content production: contributing sections, drafts, and revisions under direction
* Proofreading and editing your own drafts against 2Base brand voice guidelines before submitting



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* Content strategy and editorial planning: the Marketing Manager sets the direction and you execute within it
* Publishing decisions: a separate team member manages scheduling and publishing
* Visual design of content assets: the design function owns this
* SEO keyword selection: the SEO specialist sets this and you write within it
* Campaign strategy or audience definition
* Client\-facing communications of any kind



  





**Requirements** 




**Experience** 




  




* Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of experience. Internship experience in content writing, copywriting, journalism, or technical writing counts.
* Has written something anything that demonstrates the ability to put ideas into clear, readable sentences. College submissions, personal blogs, LinkedIn posts, college magazine articles, or internship work all qualify.
* Has used AI writing tools and understands both their value and their limits. AI is a tool in this role, not the writer.
* Background in engineering, computer science, or information technology is preferred. Graduates from other streams with demonstrated interest in technology topics are also considered.



  





**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clearly in English. Not without errors that improves with practice – but with a clear structure and a readable point.
* Can read a brief and produce something that addresses it, rather than writing whatever comes to mind
* Accepts feedback and revises drafts without treating the edit as personal criticism
* Does not pad. Does not repeat the same point in different words to fill length.



  





**Mindset** 



* Genuinely curious about technology topics: not faking interest to get the job, but actually reading and thinking about what software, AI, and digital infrastructure do in the real world
* Comfortable not knowing things and asking questions before writing rather than guessing
* Fast enough to produce a first draft within a day of receiving a brief, knowing it will be edited
* Treats writing as a skill to develop, not a talent they either have or do not have



  





**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Candidates who cannot write a coherent paragraph in English independently
* Candidates whose primary interest is social media management, graphic design, or video content, who see this as the nearest available opening
* Candidates who use AI tools as the primary author with only light editing and no independent writing ability
* Candidates who expect senior\-level scope, autonomy, or compensation from Day 1
* Candidates who apply without reading the role description and do not include a writing sample



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This role joins a marketing function that is still building. You will not step into a well\-established content operation. You will work within a documented brand voice and a defined content direction, but the volume, pace, and iteration rhythm are things you will grow into alongside the team.
 



  





 If you want to start a career in technology content writing and you are prepared to put in the work to learn how a B2B technology company communicates with senior buyers, this is a structured entry point. If you are looking for a creative writing role or a social media job, it is not.
 



  





 To apply: send your CV and one writing sample. A blog post, a college article, a LinkedIn post, or anything else you have written that shows us how you think. If you do not have a writing sample, write 200 words on any technology topic that interests you and send it with your application. Send to: talents@2basetechnologies.com
 



  





 Benefits
 



 A growth\-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

description:
**Description**
 The Analyst role within ATS ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence System) organization is responsible for working in Operations or manufacturing converting data into actionable business insights that drive continuous improvement initiatives. This role serves as an analysis expert who leverages various data platforms and analytical tools to provide timely, meaningful, and consumable information that supports operational excellence and process improvement across the organization.
   

  

 We have a 5\-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Data Analysis \& Insights
   

  

* Convert data into actionable business insights through advanced analytical techniques
* Translate business problem statements into clear analysis requirements and data specifications
* Conduct quantitative examination of key process indicators to identify opportunities for process improvement
* Perform root cause analysis using statistical methods and Lean Six Sigma tools
* Extract insights and formulate recommendations that impact processes, teams, or departments


 Data Acquisition \& Management
   

  

* Write efficient SQL queries to extract and process data from various sources
* Work with structured data in traditional data storage environments and non\-traditional sources
* Ensure data quality through cross\-checking and validation against available sources
* Convert raw data into analysis\-ready formats through descriptive statistics, aggregations, and pivots


 Reporting \& Visualization
   

  

* Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and metrics using tools like QuickSight, Tableau, or Excel
* Create appropriate charts and visualizations to effectively communicate findings
* Implement data visualization and communication tools (metrics dashboards, decks, flashes)
* Deliver regular reporting with high quality and easily digestible formats


 Stakeholder Communication \& Influence
   

  

* Communicate analysis findings and business implications effectively to stakeholders
* Work with business stakeholders to understand the value of analysis and drive consensus
* Provide visibility and updates on project timelines and deliverables
* Present deep dives and narratives that influence business direction


 Project Management
   

  

* Manage expectations and prioritize workload effectively
* Facilitate execution of ACES strategy through local management and support teams
* Oversee segments of site project portfolios, assisting project managers with execution
* Audit completed projects to verify sustained impact and partner with Finance to validate results


 Continuous Improvement Support
   

  

* Support ACES projects using Lean Six Sigma methodologies and tools
* Provide process knowledge and data collection support for improvement initiatives
* Help teams identify improvement areas and quantify benefits from effort/labor time, cost, cycle time, and defect reduction perspectives
* Drive culture of innovation and continuous improvement within teams


**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of program or project management experience
* Master's degree or above in relevant field, or 3\+ years of advanced Microsoft Word and Excel experience

**Description**
 Do you want to define the future of Internet commerce?
   

  

 Are you a top\-notch software engineer with a creative flare, strong problem\-solving skills, the drive to build and ship products fast, a solid computer science background and the desire to build Amazon's next generation Internet\-facing technology? Come talk with us about joining our team to help our team serve customers better.
   

  

 Is your next project defining a world class Internet service?
   

  

 With us, you will be building cutting\-edge applications and services in an environment of highly distributed systems used by Amazon transportation . Your innovation will provide new functionality for Amazon Transportation enabling millions of packages to move smoothly across amazon transportation network across the globe.
   

  

 Can you work at the scale of the biggest Internet companies?
   

  

 The solutions that you will deploy must scale to serve missions of customers worldwide, process thousands of transactions per minute and have an uptime greater than 99\.99%.
   

  

 Do you believe systems can always be made faster?
   

  

 If so, come be a member of Amazon’s Core Transportation Technology team. We build software systems that ensure millions of packages reach our customers in the fastest possible time. The systems you build will be at the forefront of our goal to ensure we are able to deliver packages same day or even within hours.
   

  

 Are you pedantic about code quality ?
   

  

 If so, we are looking for an individual like you to join a team of world class developers and help us write highest quality code which is readable, maintainable and can give our customers a bug free experience.
   

  

 Amazon is a premier place to build and deploy world class software
   

  

 Amazon has come a long way since opening on the World Wide Web in July 1995\. Today, we operate retail websites in multiple countries across geographies, offering products in many categories (books, media, digital, electronics etc.) worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history! The Amazon.com brand has become synonymous with a superior level of convenience, selection, low prices, and customer service.
   

  

 Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. There are a variety of ways in which we acquire items from vendors to our warehouses, ship items from one location to another, and several intermediate locations through which the package travels before reaching the customer. There are millions of such packages, each with different attributes, and different delivery requirements. What results is a highly dense graph of source, intermediate and destination nodes, with arcs between them representing possible paths for packages, with different costs and times along each arc. Accounting for all these constraints, and maximizing the number of shipments shipped, while minimizing cost, providing a variety of delivery options and maximizing delivery performance is Transportation Engineering's primary focus.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a highly agile and self driven team of talented and motivated engineers based out of Delhi. We are at the heart of Amazon transportation and are responsible for managing entire package lifecycle. Team owns the orchestration of transportation requests, state management, proactive deviation management at network level, progress tracker operations like delivery to locker, cancel and notification of transportation events to downstream clients. Come join the team that sets a high bar for software development and operational excellence practices. We use Amazon wide tools and processes to a large extent, and we also contribute to the Amazon wide arsenal of tools that all businesses use to be more effective. We are early adopters of new tools and technologies, before they become mandatory.

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* 1\+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience


**Preferred Qualifications**

**About Two Minute Reports** 




  





 Two Minute Reports is a fast\-growing B2B SaaS platform that helps marketing agencies and businesses automate reporting by connecting data from multiple marketing channels into Google Sheets and Looker Studio. We serve customers worldwide and are focused on building the most efficient reporting solution for marketers and agencies.
 



  





 We are looking for a creative and highly curious
 **YouTube Scriptwriter \& Copywriter** 
 to help us create content that educates, engages, and converts our target audience.
 



 The primary focus of this role will be
 **YouTube scriptwriting** 
 , along with writing copy for email campaigns, LinkedIn, website pages, and other marketing channels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 As a YouTube Scriptwriter \& Copywriter, you will be responsible for turning ideas, research, customer problems, and industry insights into compelling content.
 



  





 You will create YouTube scripts that capture attention, maintain curiosity, and communicate ideas clearly, while also developing marketing copy that connects with our target audience and drives action.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role requiring strong research, writing, storytelling, and audience understanding.

* Research and develop YouTube topics relevant to marketers, agencies, SaaS companies, and business owners.

* Research competitors, industry trends, customer problems, and successful content.
* Use real examples, data, case studies, and customer insights to strengthen scripts.
* Continuously improve scripts based on audience engagement and video performance.
* Repurpose existing content into different formats and content channels.



  





**Copywriting** 




  




* Write email campaigns, sequences, and newsletters.
* Create LinkedIn posts and other social media content.
* Develop compelling headlines, hooks, CTAs, and product messaging.
* Create marketing copy around customer pain points, use cases, and product benefits.
* Support sales and marketing campaigns with persuasive messaging.
* Review and improve existing copy based on performance and feedback.



  





**Research \& Audience Understanding** 




  




* Understand our target audience, including marketing agencies, marketers, and business owners.
* Research customer pain points, challenges, objections, and motivations.
* Understand what makes a prospect pay attention, engage, and take action.
* Translate customer and market insights into better content and messaging.
* Stay updated on trends in SaaS, MarTech, digital marketing, agencies, and content.



  





**Required QualificationsMust Have** 




  




* Strong written and spoken English.
* Excellent storytelling and communication skills.
* Strong research and analytical abilities.
* Ability to write engaging and conversational content.
* Ability to simplify complex ideas and explain them clearly.
* Strong understanding of audience psychology, attention, and persuasion.
* Ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into compelling messaging.
* Ability to write both long\-form content and short\-form copy.
* Strong attention to detail and willingness to iterate based on feedback.
* Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  




* Experience writing YouTube scripts or video content.
* Experience in B2B SaaS, MarTech, AdTech, analytics, or marketing.
* Experience creating content for marketers, agencies, or business audiences.
* Experience writing emails, sales messaging, or marketing campaigns.
* Experience working with customer\-facing or growth\-oriented teams.
* Understanding of content marketing, conversion copywriting, or marketing funnels.
* Familiarity with AI tools for research, ideation, and content creation.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* Someone who is genuinely curious about
 **why people buy, click, watch, and engage** 
 .
* Someone who can turn a basic idea into a compelling story.
* Someone who understands that good copy is about the audience, not just good grammar.
* Someone who can research a topic deeply and communicate the important parts simply.
* Someone who is comfortable taking feedback and rewriting until the content is strong.
* Someone who thinks about the business objective behind every piece of content.
* Someone who is willing to learn the product, market, and customers deeply.



  





  





**Why Join Two Minute Reports?** 




  




* Opportunity to create content for a growing global B2B SaaS company.
* Work directly with founders and the marketing team.
* Build content that reaches a global audience.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across YouTube, copywriting, SaaS, and marketing.
* Fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Significant learning and career growth opportunities.

title: Executive Food Safety Management System Documentation And Compliance
description:
Sunshine Vegetables is hiring an Executive — FSMS, Documentation \& Compliance for the IQF plant at Sikandrabad, Bulandshahr.
 



  





 We hold FSSC 22000 and FSSAI certification. Keeping a certificate is not a project with an end date — it is a daily discipline of record integrity, and it is where most certified plants quietly slip. A document at the wrong revision on the line, a monitoring record signed in arrears, an internal audit that ran late: none of it shows until an auditor pulls the file.
 



  





 This role exists so that never happens here. It is deliberately separate from the Head of Quality, because one person cannot maintain the document set and clear product for dispatch on the same day.
 



  





 What the role owns:
 



  





 \- Document control. Current revisions in use at the point of work, obsolete copies withdrawn, change history intact
 



 \- The record architecture — monitoring records, verification records, retention schedules — complete, legible and retrievable on demand
 



 \- Traceability and mock recall. Trace a batch from a named contract farmer's field to a dispatched carton within four hours, and prove it twice a year
 



 \- The internal audit programme on schedule, and the CAPA register closed to timeline rather than closed on paper
 



 \- Management review, HACCP annual review, and surveillance audit readiness maintained continuously, not assembled the week before
 



 \- Regulatory and customer compliance — FSSAI Schedule 4 Part II, labelling and legal metrology, buyer questionnaires and specification files
 



  





 What we are looking for:
 



  





 \- 5–10 years in food manufacturing QA, degree in Food Technology or Microbiology
 



 \- You have maintained a certified FSMS through at least one surveillance audit cycle, hands\-on with the documentation
 



 \- Certified internal auditor against FSSC 22000 or an equivalent scheme
 



 \- You write clearly in English and you are exacting about detail. Half this job is writing; the other half is noticing
 



  





 What will make you stand out:
 



  





 \- Experience extending a certified scope over a new line
 



 \- Frozen, chilled or fresh vegetable processing
 



 \- Export documentation for EU or Gulf buyers, or customer audit handling for a QSR or retail account
 



  





 Compensation as per experience. On\-site at Sikandrabad; relocation support available.
 



  





 CV to sagardeswal@sunshinevegetables.com or WhatsApp \+91 80779 24395\.
 



  




* \#Hiring \#FoodSafety \#FSSC22000 \#HACCP \#QualityAssurance \#InternalAuditor \#Compliance \#Documentation \#FoodTechnology

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About Neo** 




 AI is the most significant shift in how work gets done since the advent of the Internet — yet most organizations fail to capture its value.
 **Neo** 
 is changing that.
 



 Founded by
 **Bhavin Turakhia**
 — Co\-Founder of
 **Zeta**
 ,
 **Radix**
 , and
 **Titan**
 —
 **Neo** 
 is building an integrated, AI\-first suite of products that capture work, centralize context, and make AI a first\-class participant in every workflow:
 


* Tasket — A radically reimagined, AI\-native work management platform that centralizes context and makes AI delegation seamless for all work.
* Friday — AI Assistant, co\-worker and agent platform, pre\-integrated into Tasket, Studio, Drive and 1000\+ SaaS platforms.
* Studio — AI\-native suite for co\-creating docs, spreadsheets and diagrams collaboratively with humans and agents.
* Drive — AI\-native repository, where humans and agents can co\-work on files.
* Scribe — AI assistant for meetings that goes beyond note\-taking and actually does your work while on the call.



  





**About the Role** 




 We want someone whose job is turning PRDs and product context into documentation — and building the automation that makes that scale.
 



 You are someone who reads a spec closely, understands what a user or engineer actually needs to know, and writes it clearly. But you don't stop at writing docs one at a time: you build repeatable workflows — skill files, prompt templates, structured inputs — that let AI tools generate consistent first drafts from PRDs, tickets, and changelogs, which you then refine and own.
 



 This is a hands\-on, build\-the\-system role. It's not a pure writing job where you manually draft every page, and it's not a pure engineering job either — it's the combination: strong writing judgment paired with an automation mindset.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Read PRDs and engineering specs, and translate them into clear technical documentation — user guides, release notes, API docs, internal runbooks
 



 • Design and build documentation automations: skill files, prompt templates, and scripts that let AI tools generate consistent first\-draft docs from structured inputs
 



 • Maintain and improve those automations over time as our product and doc formats evolve
 



 • Edit and fact\-check AI\-generated drafts against source material — you're accountable for accuracy, not just fluency
 



 • Organize documentation in our workspace tools and keep information architecture clean and findable
 



 • Partner closely with PMs and engineers to fill documentation gaps and flag when a PRD lacks the detail needed to write accurate docs
 



 • Continuously push on documentation methodology and tooling as our products evolve
 



  





**Skills** 




 • Strong written communication — this is a writing\-first role; verbal fluency alone won't cut it
 



 • Technical fluency: able to read a PRD or API spec and understand it well enough to explain it accurately
 



 • Hands\-on use of AI: real experience using AI assistants for actual work, with a clear sense of what "skills"/prompts/context files are and how to build with them
 



 • Working understanding of project management and workspace tools (Confluence, Jira, Notion, or similar)
 



 • Genuine curiosity about systems and process — an instinct to automate the repeatable parts of a workflow
 



 • Comfortable with ambiguity and moving quickly
 



  





**Experience and Qualifications** 




 • Around 1–2 years of experience in technical writing, content engineering, developer relations, QA, or a similar technical\-adjacent role. Strong internship experience counts.
 



 • Exposure to product development or working alongside a product/engineering team
 



 • A background in computer science/engineering, or another field (journalism, English, technical support) paired with demonstrated technical comprehension — no specific degree required
 



  





**Equal Opportunity** 




 Neo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success.

 Join our globally recognized brand, where trust, communication, and a positive culture are at the core of everything we do. Our leadership is consistent, approachable, and supportive\-ensuring your well\-being and work\-life balance.
   

  

 We're looking for individuals who thrive in collaborative environments, are passionate about meaningful change, and want to grow in a company that puts people first.
   

  

 At Cigna, you'll be part of a purpose\-driven team that values innovation, compassion, and impact. Whether you're shaping better care experiences or supporting customers through life's key moments, your work will matter.
   

  

**Grow with us\-and help shape the future of healthcare.**
**About The Role**
 Are you a clear, organized communicator who can turn complex product and technology information into messages people can understand and act on? Our International Health Technology and Agile Product Enablement team is looking for a Business Communications Analyst to support communications across digital products, Agile delivery teams and business readiness activity.
   

  

 This Bangalore\-based role supports global stakeholders across Cigna Healthcare, including teams in the US, Hong Kong, Madrid and the UK. You will collaborate across time zones while managing work within agreed local working hours and priorities.
   

  

**You'll Be Responsible For**
* Support the planning, drafting, editing and delivery of communications for digital product releases, enhancements, incidents and operational changes.
* Translate technical updates, product changes and stakeholder feedback into clear, business\-friendly content for different audiences.
* Create or update release notes, internal emails, FAQs, user guides, stakeholder updates, presentations and SharePoint content.
* Partner with product, technology, business readiness, operations and commercial stakeholders to understand communication needs and confirm key messages.
* Maintain communication calendars, templates, distribution lists, approval records and communication repositories.
* Support translation workflows by coordinating requests, preparing content for translation, tracking review input and helping maintain consistency across languages.
* Support urgent communications by helping clarify the issue, audience impact, action required and next steps.


**Qualifications**
**What You'll Bring to the Role**
* 1 to 2 years of total experience in content management, copywriting, business communications, corporate communications or a related communications role.
* Experience drafting internal or stakeholder communications in partnership with business, product or technical subject matter experts.
* Professional\-level English language skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to write clear, accurate and audience\-focused business communications.
* Attention to detail, with experience editing, proofreading and quality\-checking content before publication or distribution.
* Oganization, planning and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize, self\-manage and follow through on assigned work.
* A proactive, collaborative and solutions\-driven working style, with confidence asking questions, flagging risks and taking initiative when information is unclear.

title: Content Lead- Discovery
description:
You will be the editor of a machine that writes for local businesses. You will not write the content. You will decide what good means, prove whether the machine is meeting it, and find the reasons when it is not.
   

  

**About Zoca**
 Zoca builds AI agents that local service businesses hire to run the parts of the business the owner cannot get to. More than 1,000 businesses use Zoca today. We started in beauty and wellness and are backed by Accel, Elevation Capital, Better Capital and GTM Fund.
   

  

 Discovery is the agent that runs a business’s online presence: its Google Business Profile, website, service pages, blogs, Google posts and reviews. It publishes on behalf of thousands of businesses every week, many of them in the same cities.
   

  

**The terrain**
 How does content written by a machine, for a business the machine only knows through data, become genuinely useful to a person searching nearby? How does it rank, and keep ranking, when the same machine is writing for the business down the street? Nobody at Zoca owns that question today. Engineers own the pipeline. Nobody owns what comes out of it.
   

  

 You would inherit a working pipeline from keywords to topics to published pages and posts, a per\-business context layer we call Brain that holds services, staff, tone and house rules, a live connection to every business’s Google Business Profile and Search Console, every review those businesses have received, and engineers who want someone to argue with about what the pipeline should produce. Over a thousand live businesses across many cities means a natural experiment running every day, if someone reads it.
   

  

**What We Know So Far**
 Google treats content produced at volume to manipulate ranking as spam, whoever wrote it. Fluent, generic content has become free, and specific, local, useful content has not. Many businesses in the same city want the same topics. And from the outside, a page that never got indexed, a page on the wrong topic, and a badly written page all look the same.
   

  

 What we do not know, and have opinions on that we will share after we hear yours: what separates two businesses’ content in the same zip code beyond the facts about each. How much business\-specific data moves ranking compared to the prose. Which content types are worth producing at all. Where a human belongs in the loop and where a human is a bottleneck dressed up as quality. And how you know a page is good before Google tells you two months later.
   

  

**What You Would Own**
* The definition of good. A rubric a person and a model can both apply, with pages that pass, pages that fail, and why.
* The weekly read. A sample of what shipped, across cities and business types, scored against the rubric, with every failure turned into a named class rather than a one\-off fix.
* The eval set. The pages the pipeline is measured against before anything goes live, and the automated judge engineering builds from it.
* Local intent, per business type. What someone searching for a lash studio wants to read is not what someone searching for a med spa wants. You decide what we produce for each, and what we stop producing.
* The outcome numbers. Pages indexed, pages earning impressions, keywords ranked, clicks, and calls and bookings we can trace back to a page. Not output volume. Where those numbers should be is yours to argue.


 If you find yourself writing blogs, something upstream is broken, and that is the thing to fix.
   

  

**Who You Probably Are**
* You have personally made local pages rank for hundreds of small businesses, at an agency or on a marketplace, and can explain exactly what did it.
* You write well and can say precisely why a paragraph is bad, in one sentence.
* You read Search Console before you form an opinion.
* You have worked with model\-generated content and hold a view of it that is neither hype nor contempt.
* You can write a rubric, argue with an engineer about an eval, and lose the argument gracefully when the data says so.
* You have real experience with US local search, wherever you sit.


 This is not a content calendar role, a people\-management role, a brand copy role or a social media role. It reports into product, works daily with the pipeline engineers, and starts with no team.
   

  

 Skills: local seo,google business profile,editorial judgment paired with seo

title: VIDEO EDITOR
description:
**Bangalore \| Full time \| 1 to 4 Years Experience****English, Hindi \& Kannada** **If you can find the 5 seconds everyone needs to see, read on.**
You know when a 30 minute speech has **one moment worth watching?**
We’re looking for a **Video Editor** who can find it, cut it, and make people stop scrolling.
This isn’t just about knowing Premiere Pro.  

It’s about having the editing instinct to know **what stays, what goes, where the cut lands, when the music hits, and what keeps someone watching.**
You understand political storytelling, short form content, internet culture, and how content moves online.### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Edit political content for **Instagram Reels, YouTube, Facebook, X \& WhatsApp**
* Turn speeches, interviews, rallies, event footage, explainers and campaign videos into sharp, engaging, platform native content
* Watch long form footage and identify the strongest **hooks, moments and soundbites**
* Create cuts, transitions, subtitles, text animations, graphics, motion and visual effects that add to the story
* Get the **pace, context and visual language** right for every platform
* Adapt videos across different formats, durations, aspect ratios and languages
* Work closely with writers, graphic designers, photographers, strategists and campaign teams
* Handle multiple edits and priorities without letting quality or attention to detail slip
* Deliver high quality work on tight deadlines

### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **1 to 4 years** of experience as a Video Editor, preferably in political campaigns, digital media, advertising, news or other high volume content environments
* Strong command of **Adobe Premiere Pro \& After Effects**
* Knowledge of **DaVinci Resolve** is a plus
* Strong understanding of **Reels, Shorts, YouTube and social first video**
* Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, music, typography and visual composition
* Ability to take raw footage and figure out **what the story actually is**
* Ability to work quickly in a fast moving, deadline heavy environment
* Strong command of **English, Hindi \& Kannada**, including the political and cultural context behind the content
* Comfortable making creative decisions independently and adapting to changing priorities

### **WHAT WILL SET YOU APART**

* You’ve edited **political campaigns, news or public facing content** before
* Strong motion graphics and animation skills
* You understand **internet culture, memes and emerging formats**
* You have a sharp eye for **colour, sound design and visual storytelling**
* You can spot a killer clip before someone has to tell you it’s a killer clip
* Your portfolio demonstrates **social first editing instincts**, not just technical skills

### **THE SKILL WE’RE REALLY HIRING FOR**

**Editing judgement.**
Knowing that the 30 minute speech has **one line that changes everything.**
Knowing when to cut.
Knowing when to hold.
Knowing when the music should hit.
Knowing what makes someone watch till the end.
We’re hiring the person who knows:**“This is the moment.”**### **WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**


This is not:**Import footage**  **make cuts**  **export**  **next.**
Politics moves fast. News breaks. Narratives change.
A clip that matters at **2 PM might be irrelevant by 6 PM.**
You’ll need to work with **speed, pressure, ambiguity and real time creative decisions.**### **WHY JOIN US?**


You’ll work at the intersection of **politics, video, culture and the internet.**
You’ll work alongside campaign strategists, writers, designers, social media teams and political professionals, creating content that is actually part of the conversation.**Your edits won’t just sit in a folder.****People will see them.**### **HOW TO APPLY**

**Don’t just send us your CV. Show us what you can do.**
Send your **CV \+ showreel/portfolio** to:**mailto:contact@designboxed.com****Bonus points for:*** 3 to 5 edits you’re genuinely proud of
* Political, news, advertising or digital campaign work
* Anything that demonstrates your **editing instinct, storytelling ability and creative judgement**

  

If you can take raw footage, find the story, and turn it into something people actually want to watch,**we want to see your work.**

title: Clinical Associate
description:
**About the Role** 
  
 



 Evervie is building a new specialty care vertical focused on women's health, a ground\-up clinical model spanning diagnosis, treatment protocols, and a physician panel. We're hiring a Clinical Associate to sit in the founder's office and work directly with the Director of Clinical Innovation across nearly every clinical workstream in the build: guidelines, patient segmentation, physician recruitment, and partner tie\-ups. This is a high\-exposure, hands\-on role for someone early in their career who wants to see how a clinical model gets built from first principles. 
 



**Location:** 
 Chennai or Hyderabad preferred (travel to both required if based elsewhere) 
 



**Contract:** 
 6 months to 1 year, with potential to continue post\-launch based on performance 
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Director of Clinical Innovation and Medical Director
 



**What you'll do:** 
  
 



*Clinical guidelines \& protocols:* 
  
 


* Support development and documentation of clinical guidelines — screening protocols, contraindication checklists, and treatment pathways
* Help map patient segmentation logic (clinical stage, care history, symptom and comorbidity modifiers) into usable guideline structures
* Research and compare Indian and international clinical guidance to identify gaps and inform local protocol decisions



*Patient scenarios \& workflow:* 
  
 


* Map real\-world patient scenarios and journeys to stress\-test clinical workflows before launch
* Support design of the consultation flow — visit structure, screening gates, and escalation pathways
* Help translate clinical logic into requirements the product and operations teams can build against



*Physician panel \& training:* 
  
 


* Support physician panel recruitment — sourcing, screening, and onboarding doctors into the network
* Help build and coordinate training curriculum and protocol onboarding for incoming panel doctors
* Support engagement with professional bodies and societies relevant to physician credibility and recruitment



*Partnerships:* 
  
 


* Support diagnostic lab and pharmacy partnership evaluation and coordination
* Help define screening/diagnostic bundles and verify partner capability against clinical requirements



*Academic \& evidence base:* 
  
 


* Support literature review and evidence\-gathering to validate the clinical model
* Help coordinate engagement with academic and professional bodies for guideline input and clinical credibility



**What we're looking for:** 
  
 


* MBBS\+ preferred; open to strong candidates from nursing or allied health backgrounds
* Genuine interest in building — comfortable with ambiguity, undefined processes, and figuring things out without a playbook
* Strong research and documentation skills; able to synthesize clinical literature and guidelines into clear, usable material
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with product, operations, and external partners, not just clinical peers
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to own tasks end\-to\-end with minimal handholding
* Strong written and verbal communication skills



**Nice to have:** 
  
 


* Prior exposure to women's health, gynaecology, or endocrinology
* Experience or coursework in clinical research, public health, or health systems
* Familiarity with telemedicine regulations or digital health delivery model

 • Hands\-on experience in composite layup (hand layup/wet layup, vacuum bagging)

* All other duties as assigned.

* Responsible for ensuring management and compliance with industry standards and codes


 of practice

 corrective and preventive actions

 The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
   

  

* Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree in scientific discipline or healthcare; Master’s, PhD, or PharmD preferred
* Experience: Minimum of 2 years of MI writing and medical content development experience
* Exceptional communication skills include written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills including the ability to independently interpret and summarize complex results.
* Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management and staff and to succeed in a matrix team setting while meetings or exceeding timelines.
* Familiarity with AMA Style guide as well as an understanding of clinical research principles and applied statistics. Familiarity with International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE), Good Publication Practices (GPP), and other medical publishing guidelines (e.g., Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta\-Analyses (PRISMA), Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE), Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials (CONSORT), etc.
* Proficient editing skills along with expertise in Microsoft Office, Acrobat and other applications.
* Experience conducting literature searches and working with tools such as PubMed, Ovid, Embase, etc.
* Experience working with reference management and citation software (e.g., EndNote, Mendeley, Citavi, etc.)
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices in relationship to Medical Information, Medical Affairs and promotional and non\-promotional materials review.
* Excellent project management skills and proven track record of being results driven; ability to manage
* Ability to conceptualize, design and deliver best in class solutions
* Highly principled – proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior
* Collaboration – Ability to work cross functionally across EVERSANA business units and with various clients, including leadership and various departments and functions of our clients
* Agile learning – Ability to support and learn about multiple disease states and therapeutic areas


**Qualifications**
* Education: PharmD (or M. Pharm or M.S. Pharm), PhD, or MD
* Experience: Strong expertise in MI content development and scientific writing, with a track record of delivering accurate, evidence\-based, and compliant medical communications.

title: Monitoring and Documentation Officer
description:
Role: Monitoring and Documentation Officer
 



 Location: Pune
 



  






 Job Purpose
 





 The Monitoring and Documentation Officer will support the effective implementation, tracking, documentation, reporting, and knowledge management processes of the Transform Schools programme. S/He/They will be responsible for collecting quality data by following established processes, maintaining accurate programme records, tracking implementation progress, coordinating routine data collection, compiling field evidence, developing written and photo\-based case studies, and documenting programme learnings, insights, success stories, and best practices.
 




  






 Key Responsibilities
 



1. Programme Monitoring and Tracking


* Develop Project Management and Evaluation Plan (PMEP) and track programme activities against approved work plans and implementation timelines.
* Maintain updated records of school visits, trainings, meetings, workshops, assessments, and field activities.
* Support programme teams in collecting routine implementation data from districts, schools, and field staff.
* Ensure timely consolidation of activity reports and progress updates from field teams.
* Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual programme progress summaries.



  






 2\. Documentation and Knowledge Management
 



* Develop and maintain organised documentation systems (digital and physical) for programme records.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of data collection, processing, and reporting to support evidence\-based decision\-making and knowledge sharing..
* Compile training reports, meeting minutes, attendance records, field visit reports, photographs, case studies, and other supporting evidence.
* Document programme learnings, best practices, innovations, and field\-level experiences.
* Draft success stories, human\-interest stories, and short programme briefs for internal and external communication.
* Support the preparation of donor documentation and programme communication materials.


- 


  






 3\. Data Compilation, Record Management and Analysis
 



* Compile quantitative and qualitative programme data received from field teams.
* Ensure completeness and consistency of data entries before submission to the central programme team.
* Maintain updated databases and trackers for programme activities and outputs.
* Support data cleaning, verification, and analysis using EXCEL, PYTHON, R, etc., in coordination with programme and M\&E teams.
* Ensure safe storage and retrieval of programme records and supporting documents.
* Lead the design, management, and continuous improvement of digital data collection systems to ensure timely, accurate, and efficient programme data capture.



  






 4\. Reporting Support
 



* Support the preparation of periodic programme reports by collating field inputs and documentation.
* Coordinate with programme teams to obtain timely updates and supporting evidence for reporting requirements.
* Assist in formatting reports, presentations, annexures, and documentation packages.
* Ensure that all reports are submitted within agreed timelines and in the required format.



  






 Essential Requirements 
 



* Bachelor's degree in social sciences, education, public administration, development studies, statistics, economics, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in programme monitoring, documentation, reporting, MIS, or administrative support in the education or development sector.
* Experience in maintaining programme records, compiling reports, and managing documentation systems.
* Familiarity with data collection formats, data analysis processes, spreadsheets, dashboard development, and digital documentation tools.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Sheets and Documents) and cloud\-based file management systems; familiarity with digital data collection tools such as KoboToolbox will be an advantage.
* Strong written communication skills in English, Marathi, and Hindi; ability to prepare clear and concise reports and documentation.
* Good organisational and time\-management skills with attention to detail.

description:
**Description**
 This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
   

  

****About EAII****
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here:
   

  

****About Evidence Action****
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

****Requirements****
 The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
   

  

 (i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water\-treatment arrangements; and
   

  

 (ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems .
   

  

 The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
   

  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe\-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan).
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution \- addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet\-based dozers and other chlorination options.


 The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
   

  

**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**
* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O\&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states


**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**
* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O\&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late\-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water\-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non\-viable across different rural water\-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising


**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**
* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale\-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale\-up


**Requirements**
* 15\+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water\-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred.
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India.
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non\-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership


**Position Location**
**This is a 6\-month consultancy engagement,** 
 with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.
   

  

 We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.

 Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.

Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**

 We build lead\-generation websites for SMBs across Europe. AI generates the first draft of website content and blogs;
 
**your job is to make sure the final output is accurate, natural, useful, and publish\-ready.** 





 You will primarily work on German\-language websites and may occasionally support similar AI\-assisted workflows across other languages.
 



**What You'll Do** 
* Review AI\-generated German website content and blogs.
* Check content against customer briefs, product/service information and quality checklists.
* Detect hallucinations, factual errors, missing information and unsupported claims.
* Fix awkward, repetitive, generic or unnatural German.
* Manually rewrite content where AI output isn't good enough.
* Write/edit CTAs, button text, headings, meta titles/descriptions and alt text.
* Apply defined
 
**SEO, AEO and GEO** 

 content best practices.
* Ensure content supports the customer's intended audience and conversion objective.
* Use GPT and other AI tools to improve quality and productivity.
* Flag unclear information instead of making assumptions.


**What We're Looking For** 
* Strong practical written German.
* Good working English.
* Strong German grammar, vocabulary and language comprehension.
* Excellent attention to detail and critical thinking.
* Ability to understand and follow structured briefs.
* Comfortable learning and working with AI tools.
* Interest in digital content, SEO, AEO and GEO.
* Ability to learn quickly and take ownership of your work.



**Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.** 





 Candidates who studied
 
**German as a third language through Class 12** 

 may also apply. Formal German degrees or certifications are not mandatory; selection will be based on demonstrated German proficiency and performance in our practical assessment.
 



**AI\-First Performance Culture** 


 At Adaan, AI isn't an occasional tool—it's part of everyday execution.
 





 We expect you to use AI intelligently while remaining accountable for the final output. “AI generated it” isn't a reason to accept inaccurate or poor\-quality content.
 





 Performance is measured on quality, timeliness and productivity, including:
 



* **97%\+ First Time Right (FTR)**
* **97%\+ On Time Every Time (OTET)**
* Brief and checklist compliance
* Content accuracy and language quality
* Effective use of AI
* Continuous productivity improvement




 Performance is reviewed through structured monthly check\-ins.
 





 Adaan works with global markets, so ownership of client delivery commitments is expected across time zones and, when genuinely required, weekends or Indian public holidays.
 



**Compensation \& Growth** 


 We follow a
 
**fixed pay \+ performance\-linked variable pay** 

 model.
 





 High performers can earn disproportionately more. Average performance earns average pay.
 
**Impact is rewarded—not effort alone.** 





 You can grow from German HITL/content quality into
 
**Senior Content Quality, SEO/AEO/GEO, Multilingual Quality, AI Content Operations or AI Workflow Optimization** 

 roles.
 



**Why Adaan?** 


 This isn't a conventional content\-writing job.
 





 You'll learn to work at the intersection of
 
**German \+ AI \+ Content Quality \+ SEO \+ AEO \+ GEO \+ Digital Operations** 

 .
 





 If you're curious about AI, strong with language, attentive to detail and want to build skills for the next generation of digital work, we'd like to hear from you.
